subject: literacy
concept: Identifying and interpreting dramatic irony and foreshadowing
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student identifies moments in a story where the reader knows something a character doesn't, discussing the effect
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an early story detail to the later event it foreshadowed
exercise.abstract: Student explains an instance of dramatic irony or foreshadowing and its effect on the reader

misconception_flags: confuses foreshadowing (a hint about the future) with a simple plot event with no forward-looking significance

interest_binding: passage content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
